53:   # Job 1: Secret Scanning with Gitleaks
54:   secret-scan:
55:     name: Secret Detection
56:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
57:     steps:
58:       - name: Checkout repository
59:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
60:         with:
61:           # Fetch full history for comprehensive secret scanning
62:           fetch-depth: 0
63: 
64:       # Cache Gitleaks database for faster subsequent runs
65:       - name: Cache Gitleaks database
66:         uses: actions/cache@v4
67:         with:
68:           path: ~/.gitleaks
69:           key: gitleaks-db-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.toml', '.gitleaks.toml') }}
70:           restore-keys: |
71:             gitleaks-db-${{ runner.os }}-
72: 
73:       - name: Run Gitleaks secret detection
74:         uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
75:         env:
76:           GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
77:           GITLEAKS_LICENSE: ${{ secrets.GITLEAKS_LICENSE }} # Optional: for enhanced features
78:         with:
79:           # Generate SARIF report for GitHub Security tab
80:           format: sarif
81:           output: gitleaks.sarif
82:           config-path: .gitleaks.toml # Optional: custom config
83: 
84:       - name: Upload Gitleaks SARIF report
85:         # gitleaks-action only writes gitleaks.sarif when leaks are
86:         # found. Don't try to upload a non-existent file (was producing
87:         # "Path does not exist: gitleaks.sarif" failures on every run).
88:         if: always() && hashFiles('gitleaks.sarif') != ''
89:         uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
90:         with:
91:           sarif_file: gitleaks.sarif
92:           category: secrets
93: 
94:       - name: Archive secret scan results
95:         if: always()
96:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
97:         with:
98:           name: gitleaks-results-${{ github.run_number }}
99:           path: gitleaks.sarif
100:           retention-days: 30

656:   # Job 8: Security Gate - Fail on Critical Issues
657:   security-gate:
658:     name: Security Gate
659:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
660:     needs: [secret-scan, dockerfile-lint, container-scan, built-image-scan, security-report]
661:     if: always()
662:     steps:
663:       - name: Checkout repository
664:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
665: 
666:       - name: Download scan results
667:         uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
668:         with:
669:           path: scan-results
670: 
671:       - name: Install jq for JSON processing
672:         run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq
673: 
674:       - name: Evaluate security findings
675:         run: |
676:           echo "🔍 Evaluating security scan results..."
677:           EXIT_CODE=0
678:           CRITICAL_ISSUES=0
679:           HIGH_ISSUES=0
680: 
681:           # Check for secrets (CRITICAL - always fail)
682:           GITLEAKS_FILE=$(find scan-results -name "gitleaks.sarif" | head -1)
683:           if [ -f "$GITLEAKS_FILE" ]; then
684:             SECRET_COUNT=$(jq '.runs[0].results | length' "$GITLEAKS_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
685:             if [ "$SECRET_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
686:               echo "❌ CRITICAL: $SECRET_COUNT potential secrets detected"
687:               CRITICAL_ISSUES=$((CRITICAL_ISSUES + SECRET_COUNT))
688:               EXIT_CODE=1
689:             fi
690:           fi
691: 
692:           # Check for critical Dockerfile issues
693:           HADOLINT_FILE=$(find scan-results -name "hadolint-merged.sarif" | head -1)
694:           if [ -f "$HADOLINT_FILE" ]; then
695:             HADOLINT_CRITICAL=$(jq '[.runs[0].results[] | select(.level == "error")] | length' "$HADOLINT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
696:             if [ "$HADOLINT_CRITICAL" -gt 0 ]; then
697:               echo "⚠️ HIGH: $HADOLINT_CRITICAL critical Dockerfile issues found"
698:               HIGH_ISSUES=$((HIGH_ISSUES + HADOLINT_CRITICAL))
699:               # Uncomment to fail on critical Dockerfile issues
700:               # EXIT_CODE=1
701:             fi
702:           fi
703: 
704:           # Check for critical/high severity container issues
705:           TRIVY_FILES=$(find scan-results -name "trivy-*.sarif" | grep -v merged)
706:           if [ -n "$TRIVY_FILES" ]; then
707:             TOTAL_HIGH_VULN=0
708:             for trivy_file in $TRIVY_FILES; do
709:               HIGH_VULN=$(jq '[.runs[0].results[] | select(.level == "error")] | length' "$trivy_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
710:               TOTAL_HIGH_VULN=$((TOTAL_HIGH_VULN + HIGH_VULN))
711:             done
712: 
713:             if [ "$TOTAL_HIGH_VULN" -gt 0 ]; then
714:               echo "⚠️ HIGH: $TOTAL_HIGH_VULN high-severity container vulnerabilities found"
715:               HIGH_ISSUES=$((HIGH_ISSUES + TOTAL_HIGH_VULN))
716: 
717:               # Fail if more than 5 high-severity vulnerabilities
718:               if [ "$TOTAL_HIGH_VULN" -gt 5 ]; then
719:                 echo "❌ CRITICAL: Too many high-severity vulnerabilities ($TOTAL_HIGH_VULN > 5)"
720:                 EXIT_CODE=1
721:               fi
722:             fi
723:           fi
724: 
725:           # Check built image vulnerabilities
726:           IMAGE_SCAN_FILES=$(find scan-results -path "*built-image-scan-results*" -name "*.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
727:           if [ -n "$IMAGE_SCAN_FILES" ]; then
728:             TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH=0
729:             for image_file in $IMAGE_SCAN_FILES; do
730:               if [ -f "$image_file" ]; then
731:                 HIGH_VULN=$(jq '[.Results[]?.Vulnerabilities[]? | select(.Severity == "HIGH" or .Severity == "CRITICAL")] | length' "$image_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
732:                 TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH=$((TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH + HIGH_VULN))
733:               fi
734:             done
735: 
736:             if [ "$TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH" -gt 0 ]; then
737:               echo "⚠️ HIGH: $TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH high/critical vulnerabilities in built images"
738:               HIGH_ISSUES=$((HIGH_ISSUES + TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH))
739: 
740:               # Fail if more than 3 critical vulnerabilities in images
741:               if [ "$TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH" -gt 3 ]; then
742:                 echo "❌ CRITICAL: Too many high/critical vulnerabilities in images ($TOTAL_IMAGE_HIGH > 3)"
743:                 EXIT_CODE=1
744:               fi
745:             fi
746:           fi
747: 
748:           # Summary
749:           echo "\n📊 Security Gate Summary:"
750:           echo "- Critical Issues: $CRITICAL_ISSUES"
751:           echo "- High Issues: $HIGH_ISSUES"
752:           echo "- Total Issues Evaluated: $((CRITICAL_ISSUES + HIGH_ISSUES))"
753: 
754:           if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
755:             echo "\n✅ Security gate passed - no critical blocking issues found"
756:             if [ "$HIGH_ISSUES" -gt 0 ]; then
757:               echo "⚠️  Note: $HIGH_ISSUES high-priority issues found but within acceptable limits"
758:             fi
759:           else
760:             echo "\n❌ Security gate failed - critical security issues must be resolved before merge"
761:             echo "\nBlocking issues:"
762:             if [ "$CRITICAL_ISSUES" -gt 0 ]; then
763:               echo "- $CRITICAL_ISSUES critical issues (secrets, etc.)"
764:             fi
765:             if [ $((HIGH_ISSUES)) -gt 10 ]; then  # Only show if excessive high issues
766:               echo "- Excessive high-priority vulnerabilities detected"
767:             fi
768:           fi
769: 
770:           exit $EXIT_CODE
771: 
772:       - name: Upload security gate results
773:         if: always()
774:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
775:         with:
776:           name: security-gate-results-${{ github.run_number }}
777:           path: security-gate-summary.txt
778:           retention-days: 90
